name: go-tests
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/extract/go-setup.sh && cd core && bun test extract-go.test.ts 2>&1

name: go-realworld
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/extract/go-setup.sh && timeout -s KILL 2400 bun research/extract/go-run.ts --out /tmp/xg 2>&1 && echo '--- results.jsonl' && cat /tmp/xg/results.jsonl && for f in /tmp/xg/rules/*.ts; do echo "--- rule $(basename $f)"; cat "$f"; done
